intro.text: Money in which wages are paid: a middle- or upper-class worker earns about 250 lak a day, often handed over as fifty green or twenty-five red.
The money used by every nation of Dayside: round coins cut from rare semi-precious gems and named for their colour. Lak with no colour given are taken to be blue.

description.text: Some merchants accept Kerztian money as well as lak.
The Darkside enclave in Kezare uses rectangular money marked with its value at all four corners and an emblem at the centre; whether it is a kind of lak or a Darkside currency is unclear.
